question: Can the two highest-value Zhao Wanli page targets now be bound to exact physical library objects: 2011 《赵万里文集》第1卷 p.197 for the Ding Huikang six-title quotation and 2018 《赵万里先生年谱长编》 pp.309–310 for the NLC 2024 Ding Huikang donor reference?
answer: Yes for exact physical-object access routing; no for page-text collation. NDL Search directly records the 2011 《赵万里文集》第1卷 as a National Diet Library holding, call number UM11-C247, bibliographic ID 023434359, 504 pages, ISBN 9787501346653; therefore p.197 is unambiguously inside the held volume. NDL Search also directly records Liu Bo's 2018 《赵万里先生年谱长编》 as an NDL holding, call number GK391-C34, bibliographic ID 029360342, 516 pages, ISBN 9787101125559; therefore pp.309–310 are unambiguously inside the held volume. The NLC-hosted 2024 article lists Ding Huikang among 1950 donors and assigns reference [30] to the 2018 chronology pp.309–310. No target page has been directly read or copied by the project, no copy request was sent, and object-specific remote-copy eligibility is not asserted.
